subject: general
question: The leaked secret investment documents known as Panama Papers' belonged to ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mossack Fonseca & Co**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Panama Papers **

 
 
• The **11.5 million secrets, encrypted documents that belonged to the Panama-based legal firm Mossack Fonseca & Co, and were leaked are known as the "Panama Papers."**
 
• The documents, known as the "Panama Papers," were published on** April 3, 2016, by the German newspaper Süddeutsche Zeitung (SZ)**.
 
• The report revealed a network of over **214,000 tax havens including individuals and organisations from 200 different countries**.
 
• **Financial details** that were previously kept private about **public figures, corporate executives, famous people, politicians, and others** are included in the leaked data.
 
• The shocking information from the Panama Papers, which included information from **1977 to 2015**, shocked the entire world.
 
• The** International Consortium of Investigative Journalists (ICIJ)** later republished the entire document on its website after the German magazine first reported the story.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indians in Panama Papers**

 
 
• There were about 500 Indian names on it, including several well-known figures from the Bollywood industry, including **Amitabh Bachchan, his daughter-in-law Aishwarya Rai, actor Ajay Devgn, businessman Vijay Mallya, etc**.
 
• The Panama Papers revealed Indians who were listed in the disclosures who allegedly owned illegal properties worth about** Rs 20,078 crore**.
 
• The **Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) chairman and representatives from the Economic Development (ED), Reserve Bank of India (RBI), and Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU)** have formed a **multi-agency group (MAG)** to oversee an investigation into the Panama Papers and similar cases of international tax leaks.
